from.place: Additive rank identity used in the proof of the differential rank formula

title: Additive finrank identity for a smooth quotient fibre
statement: Let R be a commutative ring, n,c natural numbers, f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R, and Q the indicated polynomial quotient. Assume Q is smooth over R and the conormal module has a Fin c basis. For a prime p of R and a prime q of the fibre, the sum of c and the finrank over the residue field of q of the base-changed Kähler differentials of the fibre equals n.

source.place: Lemma Tags 07CG and 07CH, split conormal sequence and fibre dimension sentence.

proof.text: Tensor the split conormal sequence for the smooth polynomial quotient with the residue field at q, use the chosen conormal basis and the polynomial coordinate basis, and identify the differential summand by Kähler differential base change and tensor associativity. The resulting direct-sum equivalence has finite-dimensional total space of rank n and first summand rank c, so its second summand has rank d with c+d=n.

lean.statement:
theorem smooth_quotient_fibre_finrank_add
    {R : Type u} [CommRing R] {n c : ℕ} (f : Fin c → MvPolynomial (Fin n) R)
    [Smooth R (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))]
    (b : Module.Basis (Fin c)
      (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))
      (Ideal.span (Set.range f)).Cotangent)
    (p : Ideal R) [p.IsPrime]
    (q : PrimeSpectrum (p.Fiber (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)))) :
    c + Module.finrank q.asIdeal.ResidueField
      (q.asIdeal.ResidueField ⊗[p.Fiber
        (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f))]
          KaehlerDifferential p.ResidueField
            (p.Fiber (MvPolynomial (Fin n) R ⧸ Ideal.span (Set.range f)))) = n
